title: ‘Dutton Ranch’ Duo Kelly Reilly and Cole Hauser Talk Season 2 After Cliffhanger Finale, New Showrunner and Taylor Sheridan
summary: "There was a moment where we were trying to figure out, 'How do we do this without him?'" Kelly Reilly, speaking with Cole Hauser, tells The Hollywood Reporter about moving from Sheridan's 'Yellowstone' to the spinoff. "It feels like we earned this second season from all the work we've done before, and that's the thing I'm most proud of."
